title: Kubernetes Deployments & Zero-Downtime Rollouts
description: Master Kubernetes Deployments: declarative updates, RollingUpdate tuning (maxSurge, maxUnavailable), failed rollout diagnosis, revision history, and instant rollbacks

terminals.name: monitor
terminals.foreground: until [ -f .kube/config ]; do sleep 1; done; clear; watch -n 1 'echo "=== DEPLOYMENTS ==="; kubectl get deploy -l app=webapp; echo ""; echo "=== REPLICASETS ==="; kubectl get rs -l app=webapp; echo ""; echo "=== PODS ==="; kubectl get pods -l app=webapp'

terminals.name: traffic
terminals.foreground: until [ -f .kube/config ]; do sleep 1; done; clear; echo "Waiting for webapp-service..."; while ! kubectl get svc webapp-service >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; SVC_IP=$(kubectl get svc webapp-service -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}'); clear; echo "=== STREAMING TRAFFIC: webapp-service ($SVC_IP) ==="; echo ""; while true; do curl -s --connect-timeout 1 http://$SVC_IP || echo "[Connection Error]"; sleep 0.5; done
